title: Large Language Model Agent as a Mechanical Designer
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This paper proposes a framework using a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM) coupled with a Finite Element Method (FEM) module to autonomously generate, evaluate, and refine structural designs. The LLM operates without domain-specific fine-tuning, relying on general reasoning to iteratively propose candidate structures, interpret FEM-derived results, and implement informed modifications grounded in structural mechanics.
